data.content_ref: inline:The 'refuted if' clause mischaracterizes the dependence: the ability to compute the repeated-digit complement without double-counting corrections would not refute the dependence of the isolated count on the complement principle — it would merely show the complement can be computed directly. The dependence (and the reduction) is on the *subtraction from the total* (900 - 252 = 648), which remains necessary regardless of how the complement 252 is obtained. A valid refutation would need to show the distinct-digit count can be arrived at without any subtraction from the universe at all, not merely that the subtrahend is computable cleanly.
